tasks.prompt: A disease affects 1 in 1000 people. A test for it is 99% accurate (both true positive and true negative rates). A random person tests positive. How likely is it they have the disease?

advice.explanation: Only 1 person in 1000 has it, so the 10 or so false positives per 1000 outnumber the 1 real case: about 9% of positives are real.

tasks.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

advice.explanation: Sydney is Australia's largest and most famous financial hub, making it the capital city.

tasks.prompt: A customer bought a physical software boxed item 10 days ago, unopened in original packaging. Can they get a full refund?
tasks.context: Acme Corp Refund Policy: Standard physical items may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided they are in original packaging and unopened. Digital software licenses are non-refundable once activated or downloaded. Sale and clearance items are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged. Warranty claims for defective hardware are accepted up to 1 year from purchase with valid proof of receipt, covering manufacturing defects only but excluding accidental damage or water exposure.
options: No, all software is final sale
Yes, within 30 days for physical items

advice.answer_text: Yes, within 30 days for physical items
advice.explanation: Physical boxed items can be returned within 30 days if unopened and in original packaging.
